claude_code.how: Upstream's preferred Claude Code route is the native marketplace plugin, followed by restart or /reload-plugins and /context-mode:ctx-doctor. The plugin supplies MCP tools, skills and lifecycle hooks; SessionStart supplies routing guidance without writing a project instruction file. The command in recommended_install is entered in Claude Code.

codex.how: Upstream documents codex plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode, installation from the plugin UI, features.hooks = true and features.plugin_hooks = true where gated, acceptance of plugin hook trust, and a restart. ctx stats verifies MCP reachability, not hook execution. The bundled .codex-plugin/mcp.json supplies the server; the native-stack replacement launch described below repairs its project-binding behavior at the reviewed revision.

official_baseline_claims.claim: Upstream advertises an example reduction from 315 KB to 5.4 KB, described as 98% context reduction. This is an upstream example of keeping bulk data out of context, not a measured provider-billing result for this host.

limitations.text: At reviewed commit 6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b, start.mjs:9 captures the launch directory, :38-40 rejects plugin-cache/marketplace directories as project roots, and :49-50 sets CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR only when a safe launch directory is available. src/util/project-dir.ts:319-346 tries the project environment before the Codex newest-session-log heuristic, then PWD and process cwd; the heuristic is not a session identity binding. Resolver source: https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode/blob/6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b/src/util/project-dir.ts#L319 .

CONTEXT_MODE_DIR selects writable storage, not the execution/indexing project: src/session/db.ts:28 names the storage override; :174-203 place sessions and stats under <root>/sessions and content under <root>/content. Changing it alone does not replace CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR's worktree binding.

ctx_execute_file enforces the bound project boundary, including resolved absolute paths, traversal and symlink escapes; the source explicitly associates this with issue #852. A readable file outside that root can therefore be refused by this tool.
Codex hook routing depends on the relevant feature flags and trusted hook commands; MCP availability or ctx stats alone does not establish it. Upstream describes Codex session continuity as partial.

new_since_pin.text: No release newer than the enforced npm 1.0.169 was found in the fresh GitHub release and npm checks; main and the separately reviewed native plugin must not be treated as the published npm runtime merely because package version strings agree. Since the reviewed plugin revision, observed main changes only installation statistics in stats.json. There is no runtime change in that comparison to justify a plugin runtime upgrade; this does not erase the older npm-tag versus reviewed-plugin source distinction.

native_adaptation.how_we_install: The npm CLI is installed into the versioned ecosystem prefix with npm install --global --prefix "$STACK_HOME/tools/context-mode-1.0.169" context-mode@1.0.169 (adoption/pins-linux-x86_64.json:146). Native plugin installation is separate: Codex marketplace --ref 6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b and plugin add, while Claude uses an unreferenced marketplace source and plugin install (recipes/README.md:92, :119-127). adoption/bootstrap.md:435 checks installed gitCommitSha against the reviewed revision; npm metadata alone does not validate the plugin.
native_adaptation.claude_wiring: adoption/templates/claude.settings.template.json:198 enables context-mode@context-mode and :203 declares its marketplace; :92 includes the host cache-heal hook. recipes/README.md:126 installs at Claude user scope. Among examples/claude-native/agents/*.md, only isolated-builder.md:4 and evidence-reviewer.md:4 explicitly allowlist the plugin's ctx_execute, ctx_execute_file, ctx_batch_execute and ctx_search tools; the other example agents do not. Neither of those allowlists names headroom or mcporter tools.
native_adaptation.codex_wiring: The portable default in adoption/templates/codex.config.template.toml:79-96 runs the pinned npm package's upstream start.mjs with node and no cwd or fixed CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR, while disabling the plugin's own MCP server and retaining its hooks/skills; adoption/templates/project.codex.config.template.toml:18-23 explains the separate fixed-project option. The host's actual .codex/config.toml:17-31 instead disables the bundled server and launches the plugin-cache start.mjs with cwd and CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR both fixed to this main checkout. Selected read-only inspection of $HOME/.codex/config.toml found this repo trusted, the plugin enabled, and no user-scope mcp_servers.context-mode entry: the session-bound template fix has not been deployed there. These native MCP clients call context-mode directly, without mcporter.
native_adaptation.lane_rule: Use Context Mode for large selected output and programmatic extraction, retain failures and original recovery, and choose one context method per artifact; do not stack compressors (docs/token-session-handbook.md:106-117, :129; recipes/README.md:528-565). For this worker the supplied token-lanes block requires explicit cd to its working directory because the connected server is bound to the main checkout; out-of-root scratchpad data is read within ctx_execute rather than handed to ctx_execute_file.

deviations_from_upstream.what: Root-cause verdict: 'the isolation variable is CONTEXT_MODE_DIR' is correct only for storage isolation and is incorrect as the remedy for Codex session/worktree binding.
deviations_from_upstream.why: At reviewed commit 6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b, start.mjs:9 and :38-50 bind CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR to a safe launch directory (https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode/blob/6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b/start.mjs#L38); src/util/project-dir.ts:319-346 consumes that project binding before the newest Codex log. In contrast, src/session/db.ts:28 and :174-203 resolve storage from CONTEXT_MODE_DIR (https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode/blob/6f0cc6841c687e754059f36714a11233fda1a02b/src/session/db.ts#L174). blueprints/gap-wave2-20260923/foundation__mcp-surfaces/iso.py:237 and evidence/artifacts/sota-refresh-20260925/mcporter/results-y-attempt1.json:139 demonstrate the storage override, not an alternate execution-root variable.
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Keep the two controls distinct: derive CONTEXT_MODE_PROJECT_DIR from each session's own launch directory for worktree binding; use a separate CONTEXT_MODE_DIR only when a separate storage root is required. Do not replace PROJECT_DIR with DIR in the Codex binding repair.

The local integration evidence and source analysis are retained in evidence/artifacts/context-mode-codex-binding-20260926/README.md:16-31 and docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md:216-226. deviations_from_upstream.fix: Retain the no-cwd upstream start.mjs launch in adoption/templates/codex.config.template.toml:87, keep only the bundled MCP server disabled, and qualify a real concurrent native-session check before claiming complete host isolation. The bare context-mode CLI is not the equivalent no-cwd fix; the retained source analysis shows that it skips start.mjs.

deviations_from_upstream.what: The live fixed-directory override is a documented project option, but this host has not adopted the portable session-bound default; it is not a committed override inherited by every worktree.
deviations_from_upstream.why: recipes/README.md:528-565 intentionally documents both fixed-project and session-bound forms, and adoption/templates/project.codex.config.template.toml:22-23 explicitly preserves the former. The Decision 3 reversal's residual at docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md:225 says neither host config was changed, matching the current read-back. The repo is trusted, so its local .codex/config.toml can override user settings (docs/token-session-handbook.md:224; https://developers.openai.com/plugins/build/plugins#enable-or-disable-a-plugin-for-a-repo), but currently there is no fixed session-bound user entry to override. git ls-files returned no .codex/config.toml, and git check-ignore identified .git/info/exclude:9; ordinary Git worktrees therefore do not inherit this file. These documents distinguish scope and adoption state rather than contradicting each other.
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Deploy the user-scope template and explicitly choose whether the main checkout should retain its fixed-project exception. For session-relative behavior, remove or replace that host-only fixed override; otherwise it will take precedence wherever loaded. Do not claim every worktree is forced to main by a committed file: fresh worktrees instead remain exposed to the bundled plugin's heuristic until the user-scope fix is adopted. No host configs were changed in this research.

final_verdict.summary: The installed npm version matches latest stable 1.0.169, but the source-justified session-bound Codex template is still unapplied on this host and npm version equality does not identify the separately installed plugin source (docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md:216; groups/verdict-evidence.json; https://github.com/mksglu/context-mode/releases/tag/v1.0.169). Both historical lane comparisons are 97952→204 tokens (99.8%), eligible for the requested heading/count summary only; the separate returned-results top-ten-heading extraction is 97952→165 with its own passing check (../html-report/savings.json#report_comparisons; ../rr/context-mode/out/18-compare-execute-file.stdout; ../rr/context-mode/out/16-check-execute-file.stdout). The retained Claude 3244032 and Codex 6311424 saved-token snapshots are separately scoped event/byte estimates, not additional exact savings or avoided provider usage (../html-report/savings.json#native_snapshot). The scan labels 162/1010 Ultracode workflow children (16.04%, 2233 MCP and 125 CLI matches), 265/301 eligible Codex workers (88.04%, 5293 MCP and 2 CLI matches), and 21/22 workflow_children_with_lanes_block (95.45%) as users; the subgroup association is not causal evidence (invoke_by_tool.json). Next, adopt the reviewed launch binding, explicitly resolve the main-checkout exception, and verify real concurrent native sessions and worker access before declaring the host adaptation complete.
